entities.summary: Lachlan David Turner is an Australian former professional rugby union player. His playing position was wing. He had a strong kicking game, which allowed him to also play at fullback. Turner has represented Australia in international Test rugby. He played Super Rugby for the New South Wales Waratahs from 2007 to 2013, before joining the Queensland Reds in 2014. Turner then joined the NSW Waratahs but tore his hamstring and had to have surgery.
